snippet.title: Hot Wheels Let’s Race™: Ultimate Speed - Official Game Announce Trailer (PEGI)
snippet.description:
Buckle up and race in Hot Wheels Let’s Race™: Ultimate Speed! It's the new high-speed racing video game inspired by the hit Netflix animated series! Join Coop and his friends as you race iconic Hot Wheels cars on over-the-top fast-paced tracks. Customize your vehicles with decals and create your own custom tracks. Take down epic bosses and speed toward the finish line! 

🔥 Available October 24, 2025 on Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC. 

Are you fast enough to win? Let’s race! 🏁

Game Features
ICONIC HOT WHEELS VEHICLES & TRACKS
Race fan-favorite cars like GT-Scorcher, Rodger Dodger™, and Duck N’ Roll across 12 over-the-top tracks inspired by the Netflix series.
MEET THE RACERS
Play as Coop, Spark, Mac, Brights, Axle, and Cruise, each with their own unique style.
FAMILY FRIENDLY RACING
Easy, drift-based controls make for fast, fun, and exciting head-to-head races for all ages.
MORE MODES, MORE FUN
Play across five game modes including Racing Camp and Track Builder, where you can create your own wild courses.
BOSS SHOWDOWNS
Take on huge bosses in high-speed battles packed with action and big finish-line moments.
COMPETE SOLO OR RACE IN MULTIPLAYER
Race through a fun solo campaign or challenge friends in local 4-player split-screen.
